same_candle_handling: When a candle's range contains both the stop and the target, the stop is presumed hit first (conservative). The only refinement is exact-tiling lower-timeframe (M1) evidence: the target is recorded first only when the M1 bars inside the candle prove it. Missing/partial M1 coverage (e.g. the early six-month window) falls back to the conservative stop-first assumption.

intrabar_evidence.note: M1 bars are used only to order a stop and a target that fall in the same higher-timeframe candle. For the M1 timeframe itself no lower resolution exists, so stop-first is always used there.

transaction_costs.model: net = gross - cost_price * volume (round-trip price cost)
transaction_costs.reliable_data_note: The OHLC dataset carries no spread, commission or swap series, so costs cannot be measured historically. Values below are clearly labelled assumptions, not measurements.

out_of_sample.method: A separate evaluator run over the chronological tail [split, end]; the in-sample block is the full-window run filtered to entries before the split. Targets (1.272 / 1.618) were fixed before any period was evaluated, so no target was chosen on the out-of-sample period.

metric_notes.win_rate: wins / closed trades, where a win is a closed trade with a positive net P&L at the central cost.
metric_notes.profit_factor: gross net profit of winners / gross net loss of losers, closed trades only; null when there are no losing closed trades.
metric_notes.expectancy: mean net P&L per closed trade.
metric_notes.max_drawdown: realized peak-to-trough of the closed-trade equity curve; it excludes floating P&L of open positions and is therefore a lower bound on true drawdown.
metric_notes.average_rr_ratio: mean reward/risk of closed trades; only defined when a target exists (null for the stop-only baseline).
metric_notes.end_of_data_positions: positions still open at the end of the data, marked to the final close; excluded from win rate, profit factor and expectancy and reported separately.
metric_notes.overall_row: the 'ALL' rows sum trades across timeframes; max drawdown is reported per timeframe only because each timeframe ran as an independent simulated account.

reproducibility: Reports are deterministic for a fixed dataset and clock; only generated_at_utc varies.
order_submission: Not called. No MetaTrader order-execution function is imported or invoked anywhere in the backtest comparison path.
